# feature commands

Every `feature` command, with the arguments and options the console actually defines.

## `feature:list`

List feature flags, their value and where it comes from.

```bash
bin/semitexa feature:list
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--tenant` | yes |
| `--user` | yes |
| `--json` | no |

## `feature:set`

Set a feature flag: on, off, a percentage (25%), or clear.

```bash
bin/semitexa feature:set "<flag>" "<value>"
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--tenant` | yes |
| `--user` | yes |
| `--force` | no |
